parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.73) between `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.returnsV2WhenFeatureFlagIsV2` and `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.clearingOverrideRevertsToFeatureFlag` is characteristic of test methods that exercise related but distinct behavioural scenarios — feature-flag activation and override-clearing — within the same test class. Merging or extracting these methods would obscure test intent and couple distinct assertions. No production code is involved, so no shared-code benefit accrues.
